public_context.environment_introduction:
# Environment Information

## Brief Introduction:  
This environment is a web-based support group platform designed for members to interact, share, and record their experiences.  
It maintains user accounts, group memberships, discussion threads, and journal entries, allowing for secure and private reflection or optional sharing within groups.  
Such a platform naturally facilitates the creation, storage, and retrieval of journal entries in the context of group support and community interaction.

## Environment Rules / Constraints:  
- Only users who are members of a support group may share journal entries within that group.
- Journal entry visibility is controlled by user settings (private vs group-shared).
- Group membership status (active, pending, removed) determines access rights to group content.
- Discussion threads must belong to a valid support group.
public_context.task:
Perform two moderator actions:

1) Onboard Bernard Fox (user_id U002) to the “Finding Balance” group (group_id G001):
- Activate his pending membership in G001.
- Create a new discussion thread in G001 titled “Anxiety Journaling Tips” with Bernard (U002) as the creator.
- Create a new group-shared journal entry in G001 for Bernard. The content must start with the exact sentence from his existing private entry about starting journaling for anxiety, followed by “ — Would love any tips from the group.” Do not alter his original private entry.

2) Moderate banned user Erin Joubert (user_id U004):
- For every group where Erin currently has a membership, change her membership status to “removed.”
- Delete all of Erin’s group-shared journal entries in those groups.
- Delete any discussion threads Erin created in those groups.

function.description:
Retrieve full information for a user by user ID.

Args:
    user_id (str): Unique identifier for the user.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": UserInfo  # Dictionary containing name, email, account status, etc.
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # 'User not found'
    }

Constraints:
    - The user ID must exist in the platform's user registry.
function.name: get_user_info

function.description:
Retrieve details (name, description, privacy setting) for a support group by group ID.

Args:
    group_id (str): Unique identifier of the support group.

Returns:
    dict:
        - success: True and data (SupportGroupInfo) if group exists.
        - success: False and error string if not found.

Constraints:
    - If the specified group_id does not exist, returns failure.
function.name: get_support_group_info

function.description:
List all support groups to which a user is a member, along with membership status.

Args:
    user_id (str): User's unique ID.

Returns:
    dict:
        success: True if query successful, False if user not found.
        data: List of dicts with group info and membership status:
              [
                  {
                    "group_id": str,
                    "group_name": str,
                    "membership_status": str
                  },
                  ...
              ]
        error: Present only if user doesn't exist.
Constraints:
    - User must exist in the system.
    - Includes all membership statuses.
function.name: list_user_groups

function.description:
Query and validate a user's membership status in a specific support group.

Args:
    user_id (str): ID of the user.
    group_id (str): ID of the support group.

Returns:
    dict:
    - Success: { "success": True, "data": MembershipInfo }
    - Failure: { "success": False, "error": <reason> }

Constraints:
    - User and group must exist.
    - Membership must exist for this user/group pair.
function.name: check_membership_status

function.description:
Check whether the given support group exists and is valid for further operations.

Args:
    group_id (str): The unique identifier of the group.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": True,  # Group exists and is valid
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # Reason for failure (group doesn't exist or is invalid)
    }

Constraints:
    - Only groups present in self.groups are considered valid.
    - No explicit 'deleted' status modeled; group is valid if it exists.
function.name: verify_group_validity

function.description:
List all members of a specified support group, including their membership status.

Args:
    group_id (str): The ID of the support group.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": List[Dict]  # Each dict contains user info & membership status
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # Reason (e.g. group not found)
    }

Constraints:
    - group_id must reference an existing support group.
    - Returns all associated memberships (any status).
    - If a membership points to a missing user, returns entry with 'user_id' and membership_status only.
function.name: list_group_members

function.description:
Retrieve all journal entries authored by a particular user.

Args:
    user_id (str): The unique identifier of the user.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": List[JournalEntryInfo],  # List of journal entries by this user (can be empty)
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # Error message if user does not exist
    }

Constraints:
    - The user must exist in the platform.
    - No membership or visibility filtering is applied; returns all entries authored by the user.
function.name: list_journal_entries_by_user

function.description:
Retrieve all journal entries shared within a specific support group.

Args:
    group_id (str): The unique id of the support group.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": List[JournalEntryInfo],  # All entries with group_id and visibility 'group-shared'
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # Reason for failure, e.g. group does not exist
    }

Constraints:
    - The group_id must exist in the system.
    - Only journal entries with group_id == group_id and visibility == "group-shared" are retrieved.
function.name: list_journal_entries_in_group

function.description:
Retrieve full information and visibility details for a specific journal entry.

Args:
    entry_id (str): Unique identifier of the journal entry.

Returns:
    dict: On success,
        {
            "success": True,
            "data": JournalEntryInfo
        }
        On failure,
        {
            "success": False,
            "error": "Journal entry not found"
        }

Constraints:
    - Simply retrieves existing entry info; does not require membership or visibility checking.
    - Entry must exist in self.journal_entries.
function.name: get_journal_entry_info

function.description:
Retrieve all discussion threads that belong to a specified support group.

Args:
    group_id (str): The ID of the support group.

Returns:
    dict:
        - success: True and data: list of DiscussionThreadInfo (may be empty if no threads)
        - success: False and error: str (if the group does not exist)

Constraints:
    - group_id must refer to a valid (existing) support group.
function.name: get_discussion_threads_in_group

function.description:
Get key info for a discussion thread: title, creator, timestamp, and group.

Args:
    thread_id (str): Unique identifier of the discussion thread.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": {
            "thread_id": str,
            "title": str,
            "created_by": str,
            "timestamp": str,
            "group_id": str
        }
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # Reason, e.g. thread not found
    }

Constraints:
    - The thread with the given thread_id must exist.
function.name: get_thread_info

function.description:
Add a new journal entry for a user, with optional group association and specified visibility.

Args:
    user_id (str): ID of the user creating the entry.
    content (str): Journal entry text/content.
    visibility (str): "private" or "group-shared".
    group_id (Optional[str]): If visibility is "group-shared", must specify valid group_id.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": "Journal entry created"
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str
    }

Constraints:
    - User must exist.
    - If visibility=="group-shared":
        - group_id must be provided and exist.
        - user must have active membership in group.
    - If visibility=="private":
        - group_id must be None.
    - entry_id must be unique.
function.name: create_journal_entry

function.description:
Change a journal entry's visibility setting (private or group-shared).

Args:
    entry_id (str): The ID of the journal entry to update.
    new_visibility (str): The desired visibility; must be "private" or "group-shared".

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": "Journal entry visibility updated." | "Visibility already set."
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str
    }

Constraints:
    - Only allow "group-shared" if the entry is associated with a group *and*
      its author is an active member of that group.
    - Visibility must be "private" or "group-shared".
function.name: update_journal_entry_visibility

function.description:
Establish a new support group.

Args:
    group_name (str): Desired support group name (must be unique).
    description (str): Descriptive text for the support group.
    privacy_setting (str): Group privacy setting string (e.g. "public", "private").

Returns:
    dict: On success:
        {
            "success": True,
            "message": "Support group created with group_id <id>"
        }
    On failure:
        {
            "success": False,
            "error": "reason for failure"
        }

Constraints:
    - group_name must be unique among all support groups.
    - Group will be assigned a unique group_id internally.
function.name: create_support_group

function.description:
Adds or updates a membership for a user in a specified support group.

Args:
    user_id (str): The ID of the user.
    group_id (str): The ID of the support group.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": str  # Description of the operation (added or updated),
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # Reason for failure (user/group not found),
    }

Constraints:
    - User and group must exist.
    - Membership status will be set to 'active'.
    - If membership for user/group exists (any status), update to 'active', otherwise create a new record.
    - join_date is set to current date/time (ISO format).
function.name: add_membership_to_group

function.description:
Update the status of a user's membership in a group.

Args:
    membership_id (str): The ID of the membership record to update.
    new_status (str): The target status value ('active', 'pending', 'removed').

Returns:
    dict: If successful: { "success": True, "message": "Membership status updated to <new_status>." }
          If membership does not exist or status is invalid: { "success": False, "error": str }

Constraints:
    - membership_id must exist in the environment.
    - new_status must be one of {"active", "pending", "removed"}.
    - The membership status will be updated in-place.
function.name: change_membership_status

function.description:
Start a new discussion thread within a valid support group.

Args:
    group_id (str): The ID of the support group.
    title (str): The title of the discussion thread.
    created_by (str): The user ID who initiates the thread.

Returns:
    dict:
        - On success: {"success": True, "message": "Discussion thread created in group <group_id>"}
        - On failure: {"success": False, "error": "<reason>"}

Constraints:
    - The group_id must correspond to an existing group.
    - The created_by user must exist.
    - The thread_id must be unique (auto-generated).
    - title must be a non-empty string.
function.name: create_discussion_thread

function.description:
Remove a journal entry from the platform.

Args:
    entry_id (str): The journal entry's unique identifier.

Returns:
    dict: 
        On success:
            { "success": True, "message": "Journal entry deleted." }
        On failure (entry not found):
            { "success": False, "error": "Journal entry not found." }

Constraints:
    - Only deletes if entry_id exists.
function.name: delete_journal_entry

function.description:
Remove a discussion thread from a group.

Args:
    thread_id (str): The ID of the discussion thread to be deleted.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": "Discussion thread <thread_id> deleted."
    }
    OR
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # Reason: thread does not exist, invalid group, etc.
    }

Constraints:
    - The discussion thread must exist.
    - The thread must belong to a valid support group.
function.name: delete_discussion_thread

function.description:
Modify the content of an existing journal entry.

Args:
    entry_id (str): The journal entry to be modified.
    user_id (str): The user requesting the update (must be entry owner).
    new_content (str): Replacement content for the entry.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": "Journal entry content updated successfully"
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": "reason"
    }

Constraints:
    - Journal entry must exist.
    - Only the owning user may update a journal entry.
    - Content must not be None.
    - Updates to timestamps are not required by rules, but may be performed for consistency.
function.name: update_journal_entry_content

function.description:
Modify the description and/or privacy setting of a support group.

Args:
    group_id (str): Identifier for the support group to update.
    description (Optional[str]): New description text, if update desired.
    privacy_setting (Optional[str]): New privacy setting, if update desired.

Returns:
    dict: 
        On success:
            {
                "success": True,
                "message": "Support group information updated."
            }
        On error:
            {
                "success": False,
                "error": "Support group not found."  # or
                "error": "No update fields provided."
            }
Constraints:
    - Group must exist.
    - At least one of description or privacy_setting must be provided.
    - Only non-None fields are updated.
function.name: update_support_group_info

Retrieve all discussion threads that belong to a specified support group.

Args:
    group_id (str): The ID of the support group.

Returns:
    dict:
        - success: True and data: list of DiscussionThreadInfo (may be empty if no threads)
        - success: False and error: str (if the group does not exist)

Constraints:
    - group_id must refer to a valid (existing) support group.
function.name: get_discussion_threads_in_group

function.description:
Get key info for a discussion thread: title, creator, timestamp, and group.

Args:
    thread_id (str): Unique identifier of the discussion thread.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": {
            "thread_id": str,
            "title": str,
            "created_by": str,
            "timestamp": str,
            "group_id": str
        }
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # Reason, e.g. thread not found
    }

Constraints:
    - The thread with the given thread_id must exist.
function.name: get_thread_info

function.description:
Add a new journal entry for a user, with optional group association and specified visibility.

Args:
    user_id (str): ID of the user creating the entry.
    content (str): Journal entry text/content.
    visibility (str): "private" or "group-shared".
    group_id (Optional[str]): If visibility is "group-shared", must specify valid group_id.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": "Journal entry created"
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str
    }

Constraints:
    - User must exist.
    - If visibility=="group-shared":
        - group_id must be provided and exist.
        - user must have active membership in group.
    - If visibility=="private":
        - group_id must be None.
    - entry_id must be unique.
function.name: create_journal_entry

function.description:
Change a journal entry's visibility setting (private or group-shared).

Args:
    entry_id (str): The ID of the journal entry to update.
    new_visibility (str): The desired visibility; must be "private" or "group-shared".

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": "Journal entry visibility updated." | "Visibility already set."
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str
    }

Constraints:
    - Only allow "group-shared" if the entry is associated with a group *and*
      its author is an active member of that group.
    - Visibility must be "private" or "group-shared".
function.name: update_journal_entry_visibility

function.description:
Establish a new support group.

Args:
    group_name (str): Desired support group name (must be unique).
    description (str): Descriptive text for the support group.
    privacy_setting (str): Group privacy setting string (e.g. "public", "private").

Returns:
    dict: On success:
        {
            "success": True,
            "message": "Support group created with group_id <id>"
        }
    On failure:
        {
            "success": False,
            "error": "reason for failure"
        }

Constraints:
    - group_name must be unique among all support groups.
    - Group will be assigned a unique group_id internally.
function.name: create_support_group

function.description:
Adds or updates a membership for a user in a specified support group.

Args:
    user_id (str): The ID of the user.
    group_id (str): The ID of the support group.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": str  # Description of the operation (added or updated),
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # Reason for failure (user/group not found),
    }

Constraints:
    - User and group must exist.
    - Membership status will be set to 'active'.
    - If membership for user/group exists (any status), update to 'active', otherwise create a new record.
    - join_date is set to current date/time (ISO format).
function.name: add_membership_to_group

function.description:
Update the status of a user's membership in a group.

Args:
    membership_id (str): The ID of the membership record to update.
    new_status (str): The target status value ('active', 'pending', 'removed').

Returns:
    dict: If successful: { "success": True, "message": "Membership status updated to <new_status>." }
          If membership does not exist or status is invalid: { "success": False, "error": str }

Constraints:
    - membership_id must exist in the environment.
    - new_status must be one of {"active", "pending", "removed"}.
    - The membership status will be updated in-place.
function.name: change_membership_status

function.description:
Start a new discussion thread within a valid support group.

Args:
    group_id (str): The ID of the support group.
    title (str): The title of the discussion thread.
    created_by (str): The user ID who initiates the thread.

Returns:
    dict:
        - On success: {"success": True, "message": "Discussion thread created in group <group_id>"}
        - On failure: {"success": False, "error": "<reason>"}

Constraints:
    - The group_id must correspond to an existing group.
    - The created_by user must exist.
    - The thread_id must be unique (auto-generated).
    - title must be a non-empty string.
function.name: create_discussion_thread

function.description:
Remove a journal entry from the platform.

Args:
    entry_id (str): The journal entry's unique identifier.

Returns:
    dict: 
        On success:
            { "success": True, "message": "Journal entry deleted." }
        On failure (entry not found):
            { "success": False, "error": "Journal entry not found." }

Constraints:
    - Only deletes if entry_id exists.
function.name: delete_journal_entry

function.description:
Remove a discussion thread from a group.

Args:
    thread_id (str): The ID of the discussion thread to be deleted.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": "Discussion thread <thread_id> deleted."
    }
    OR
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # Reason: thread does not exist, invalid group, etc.
    }

Constraints:
    - The discussion thread must exist.
    - The thread must belong to a valid support group.
function.name: delete_discussion_thread

function.description:
Modify the content of an existing journal entry.

Args:
    entry_id (str): The journal entry to be modified.
    user_id (str): The user requesting the update (must be entry owner).
    new_content (str): Replacement content for the entry.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": "Journal entry content updated successfully"
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": "reason"
    }

Constraints:
    - Journal entry must exist.
    - Only the owning user may update a journal entry.
    - Content must not be None.
    - Updates to timestamps are not required by rules, but may be performed for consistency.
function.name: update_journal_entry_content

function.description:
Modify the description and/or privacy setting of a support group.

Args:
    group_id (str): Identifier for the support group to update.
    description (Optional[str]): New description text, if update desired.
    privacy_setting (Optional[str]): New privacy setting, if update desired.

Returns:
    dict: 
        On success:
            {
                "success": True,
                "message": "Support group information updated."
            }
        On error:
            {
                "success": False,
                "error": "Support group not found."  # or
                "error": "No update fields provided."
            }
Constraints:
    - Group must exist.
    - At least one of description or privacy_setting must be provided.
    - Only non-None fields are updated.
function.name: update_support_group_info
